children: ICICI Securities's research report on Blue Jet Healthcare

Blue Jet Healthcare (BlueJet)’s Q2FY27 print was strong, with revenue/EBITDA growth of 127%/116% YoY. This is in line with the company’s guidance of a strong outlook for FY27 for its two critical segments – contrast media and pharma intermediate. We note the PI segment, particularly, could experience volatile quarters, depending upon supplies to innovators. Even so, we believe revenue momentum could sustain for H2FY27 as well. BlueJet has seen margin pressure from sharp rises in prices for ancillary chemicals such as reagents and solvents, which are not part of its pass-through mechanism; the company is making efforts to raise prices for select products and customers. It remains hopeful of new product development across segments, and expects a commercial ramp-up to coincide with its Vizag facility.
We tweak our FY27E/ FY28E EPS and revise TP to INR 665 (vs. INR 680) based on an unchanged FY28E P/E multiple to 35x. Retain BUY.
